name: publicWeb_savePasskey
description: Binds a WebAuthn credential to the calling browser's own HC.Device row (E9.F7.S6). The registration ceremony is verified by the Next.js route (@simplewebauthn/server) — SQL cannot check an attestation — so this SP proves the caller is a signed-in device (HC6.ValidateAppAuth, spNumber 110, token signed for 'publicWeb_savePasskey') and stores the key against THAT device (id = @deviceId AND UserId = caller) and no other. Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's device id No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Token for this SP's name, paramString = deviceSecret No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicKey
parameters.description: base64url COSE key No SQL default.

parameters.name: transports
parameters.description: Comma list of authenticator transports ('internal,hybrid'), a hint for the browser.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always first. success 1 after the commit; 0 with ValidateAppAuth's code/type on auth failure; 0 with 1210/12 when credentialId or publicKey is empty; 0 with 1500/5 from the CATCH.
On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth detail) and on 1210 ('Passkey incomplete', logged first). The CATCH (1500/5) returns the envelope alone, with no detail rowset.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Device SET PasskeyCredentialId, PasskeyPublicKey, PasskeyCounter, PasskeyTransports WHERE id = @deviceId AND UserId = @userId (replaces any passkey this device held).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1210 and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK); ValidateAppAuth logs auth failures.

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken, @counter. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
